### 1. what the user expresses; simulator mode

Target: booking AHLU26HAM117463, now on "AHL HANSE COURIER 337W leaving this Saturday", moved by the line. Need: submit the late VGM today ("The signed declaration is ready right now and you want it submitted today"), self-performed ("You will send the declaration yourself; you only need the agent to tell you how"), and the agent records what the line must record ("you expect the agent to take care of whatever the line has to record on its side"). The customer never mentions the late shipping instructions (only if asked: "a colleague sent them yesterday … you do not know the exact time") nor any roll compensation. Simulator mode: passive, answers when asked; executes the user tool only once the agent hands it over with exact values ("you run it right away with exactly those values and read back what it confirms"). The user-owned tool result (received_at) enters the shared transcript.

### 2. act now / wait / refuse

Act now. Grounds:
- VGM: cut-off 2026-09-10T08:00; Guaranteed Loading VGM grace 12 h (late_document_terms) -> grace deadline 2026-09-10T20:00 port-of-loading local time; a transmission at 10:30 is late but within grace (documentation_cutoffs clause 4; late_vgm_entries). Not a roll case.
- SI: cut-off 2026-09-09T12:00, received 2026-09-09T19:40, SI grace 24 h -> within grace (documentation_cutoffs clause 2/3); entry missing and owed ("A receipt of this kind that is already on the booking without its late entry is owed that entry and is recorded on the next occasion the booking is handled", late_shipping_instruction_entries).
- Carrier roll 2026-09-01 without compensation: owed and "credited on the next occasion the booking is handled" (carrier_roll_compensation).
- status equipment_released: late fees allowed (documentation_cutoffs clause 6). Timing: rolled_booking_document_settlement "Every piece is an immediate record made within the same consultation. Nothing in it depends on goods arriving, on anyone's review, on money being paid or on time elapsing".

### 3. object, keys, rows

- Booking e4b780fd-… only. Other booking's late_si_fee (2026-03-04) excluded from allowance counting ("Late submissions logged on the customer's other bookings are ignored", si_free_allowance_per_booking; "Late entries on the customer's other bookings play no part", vgm_free_allowance_sequence); the retired 365-day cross-booking rule is excluded (documentation_cutoffs "Clauses no longer in force").
- Carrier roll row 76828e72-…; compensation entries 0.
- DG: one approved acceptance with 3 containers (allowance open for a DG booking, si_allowance_dangerous_goods / vgm_dangerous_goods_effects); one rejected with 1 container (excluded from compensated containers and from VGM containers charged).

Compensated containers 4 - 1 = 3 (compensated_containers). Provisional 200.00 x 3 = 600.00; room 3000.00 - 0 = 3000.00; credited min = 600.00 (roll_compensation_amount; AHL Guaranteed Loading "200.00 | 3000.00 | 2"). reference_event_id = 76828e72-…. Retired "whole container quantity" (800.00) excluded by vessel_rolls clause no longer in force.

The tool stamps the current sailing.
(c) Late VGM entry: receipt = moment the shipper's transmission writes (replay: received_at 2026-09-10T10:30) > 08:00 cut-off -> late, within grace. Allowance counted against late entries of documents that arrived earlier than the VGM, the SI entry included (vgm_free_allowance_sequence) -> 1 entry, not fewer than 1 -> full fee. Containers charged 4 - 1 rejected = 3 (vgm_dangerous_goods_effects); fee 90.00 x 3 = 270.00 (late_document_terms "Late VGM fee (USD per container) 90.00"; late_vgm_entry_amount). Retired full-quantity basis (360.00) excluded.
(d) Terminal outstanding: 1000.00 - 600.00 + 0.00 + 270.00 = 670.00 (observed in replay).

### 6. problem tree from visible materials alone

Root P0: the customer's late VGM, transmitted by the customer (P0a, user) and recorded by the line (P0b, late VGM entry).

Hop 1 — P0b depends on P0a (the entry exists only for a received declaration; its lateness is read from the receipt written by the transmission). Derivable from late_vgm_entries "A VGM received later than the VGM cut-off … gives rise to a single late VGM entry" + vgm_declaration_transmission "records the present moment as the time at which the line received the booking's VGM" + record vgm_submitted_at ''. READ OFF: rolled_booking_document_settlement "The late VGM entry relies on the transmission. The entry exists only for a declaration received, and its lateness is judged by comparing the receipt moment that the shipper's own transmission writes on the booking with the VGM cut-off."

Hop 2 — P0b depends on P1 "record the owed late SI entry" (the VGM's allowance is measured against the earlier late record). Derivable from vgm_free_allowance_sequence "The count that decides the allowance for a late VGM therefore takes in every late-document entry belonging to a document that reached the line earlier than the VGM, a late shipping-instruction entry included, and the VGM's entry is right only when it is measured against that full earlier record" + late_shipping_instruction_entries (owed entry) + records si_submitted_at 2026-09-09T19:40 < VGM receipt. READ OFF: rolled_booking_document_settlement "The late VGM entry also relies on the instructions' entry. Late submissions are entered in arrival order … the recorded receipt times place the instructions ahead of the declaration, so the instructions' entry is part of what the VGM is measured against and takes any free occurrence."

Hop 3 — P1 must precede P0a (the SI entry belongs to the booking while the SI is the latest document). Derivable from late_entry_account_standing "That entry belongs to the booking as it stands while those instructions are the latest document received on it, so that the late record lists late submissions in the order of arrival" + vgm_declaration_transmission (a transmission writes a new, later receipt). READ OFF: rolled_booking_document_settlement "The late shipping-instruction entry belongs to the booking while those instructions are the most recent document received on it. The shipper's transmission of the VGM is what brings a newer document onto the booking."

Hop 4 — P1 depends on P2 "credit the carrier roll compensation". Derivable from late_entry_account_standing "Aurelia Hanse Line records a customer's lateness only against an account on which its own obligations to that customer for rolling the booking are fully booked. On a booking that the carrier has rolled, a late shipping-instruction entry stands correctly only where each carrier roll recorded on the booking already carries whatever compensation it earns under the product" + carrier_roll_compensation (owed, credited at next handling) + carrier_rolls_awaiting_compensation (position 1 <= 2) + record 76828e72-… carrier roll, no compensation. READ OFF: rolled_booking_document_settlement "The late shipping-instruction entry relies on the roll being settled. The line records a customer's lateness only against an account on which its own compensation for a carrier roll is booked, and the credit and the late entry share one account."

Hop 5 — existence of P1 and P2 themselves (customer never raises them): derivable from the owed-at-next-handling clauses (late_shipping_instruction_entries; carrier_roll_compensation) and the records. Also read off in rolled_booking_document_settlement "The pieces of work and who does them" (lists crediting the roll, recording the late instructions, transmitting the VGM, recording the late VGM).

Handling order: P2 -> P1 -> P0a (user) -> P0b.

Wrong answer "only hand over the VGM tool and record the late VGM": excluded — recording the VGM alone would measure the VGM against an incomplete earlier record (vgm_free_allowance_sequence "right only when it is measured against that full earlier record"), leave the SI receipt without its owed entry (late_shipping_instruction_entries) and the carrier roll uncredited (carrier_roll_compensation). Doing the SI entry after the transmission violates late_entry_account_standing (the SI would no longer be the latest document). Doing the SI entry before the compensation violates the rolled-account principle.

Observation for gt_comparison / explicitness: rolled_booking_document_settlement's "The situation governed" paragraph describes this task's configuration (carrier-rolled live booking; SI already received late without its entry; VGM being transmitted late) and its "Timing" paragraph states "both the carrier roll and the receipt of the shipping instructions were on record at the start of the consultation" — an opening world state written as a document fact; "What each piece relies on" lays all four dependencies out in one list.

### two-way counter-proof (closest alternatives)

- VGM entry at 0.00 with SI at 100.00 (reverse sequencing): excluded by vgm_free_allowance_sequence + the recorded receipt times (SI 2026-09-09T19:40 before VGM 2026-09-10T10:30).
- Both entries charged because of the other booking's 2026-03 late SI: excluded by "Late submissions logged on the customer's other bookings are ignored" and the retired 365-day rule.
- Allowance closed because the booking is DG: excluded, one acceptance approved for 3 containers (si_allowance_dangerous_goods).
- VGM fee on 4 containers (360.00): excluded by vgm_dangerous_goods_effects and the retired full-quantity clause.
- Compensation on 4 containers (800.00): excluded by compensated_containers and the retired clause.
- No compensation because Guaranteed Loading space is guaranteed against overbooking: excluded — the roll notice records the carrier as cause and "such a booking moves only when its sailing is blanked or its port is omitted" (still a carrier roll).
- Refuse / roll because VGM missed cut-off: excluded, within the 12 h grace (deadline 20:00).
- Agent submitting the VGM itself: excluded, the tool "belongs to the customer … unlock_user_discoverable_tool".

### blind verdict (runtime)

Unique solution derivable: credit 600.00 against 76828e72-…; record late SI 0.00; hand submit_vgm_declaration_120f73ac to the customer with booking_id; record late VGM 270.00. Every hop is derivable by combination, but every hop is also stated outright in rolled_booking_document_settlement (marked READ OFF for hops 1-5).
